_meanings:
.²1 Not nourished or fed, lean, not fat.
.²2 Not loud or violent, soft, low (as sound).
.²3 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) Not feeding or assisting (the meaning), irrelevant ({#muKyAnupakArin#}),
 regarded as one of the {%arthadoṣas%} (faults of the sense or meaning);
 as in the instance given under <ls>S. D. 576</ls> {#vilokya vitate vyomni viDuM#}
 {#muYca ruzaM priye#}, the adjective {#vitata#} ‘expanded’, as applied,
 to the sky, does not in any way help the cessation of anger and is, therefore, irrelevant.
